# Questions the policy service refuses instead of deciding, one key per
# line: subject, action, resource. Each answers INVALID_ARGUMENT, "the
# evaluation does not fit the schema": policy/schema/iam.cedarschema
# lists Operator as a principal of a few actions only (ADR-0146), and
# these are the others. The platform denies each, since no route admits
# an operator to the action. docs/architecture/policy-matrix.md
# explains.
